Sen Boutique Hotel Check-in date Check-out date Check Availability Welcome to SEN HOTEL GROUP Sen Hotel Group, a chain of hotels under a symbolic name “Sen”: Sen Grand Hotel & Spa, Sen Luxury, Sen Hotel with over 200 rooms. The accommodation is decorated in business style with a convenient location in Nguyen Khanh Toan Street, Cau Giay District, Hanoi City. 05 mins to Lotte Tower 07 mins to Keangnam Landmark 72 10 mins to National Convention Center 15 mins to Downtown 20 mins to Noi Bai International Airport Easy to access to industrial zones: Thang Long, Quang Minh, Bac Ninh, Thai Nguyen, Hai Phong... The contemporary "Live Sen Dream" spacious rooms: Standard, Superior, Grand Superior, Deluxe, Grand Deluxe, Premium, Executive and Suite with full equipped facilities make Sen Hotel Group the ideal place to stay, including short or long stay, alone or with colleagues, family and friends.
